key_insight: Train an attention graph neural network directly from finite-volume residuals, eliminating the need for labeled CFD data while preserving thermo-fluid accuracy.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster and cheaper surrogate modeling for coupled thermo-fluid simulations, reducing both data-generation cost and storage burden in scientific machine learning workflows.
method: Build an attention GNN on the simulation mesh.
Define the loss as the finite-volume residuals of the governing equations.
Optimize the network without supervised labels, using mesh-based physics residuals as the training signal.
evidence_signal: Across four test scenarios, the FVM-loss model reached 2.3–2.8% all-field nRMSE on the two steady-state benchmarks and outperformed a data-supervised baseline on the two transient cases.
watch_item: Residual-based training depends on accurate mesh discretization and equation implementation, so stability and generalization may be sensitive to solver fidelity and problem setup.
paper_title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
